name: Improved Perlin Noise (4D)
definition: A GPU-based implementation of 4D Perlin noise using texture-based permutation and gradient tables to avoid branching and improve performance over traditional array-based lookup.
summary: Improved Perlin Noise (4D) extends the 3D algorithm to four dimensions, treating time as the fourth axis to enable smooth, continuous random values for time-varying texture generation and animation.
